reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: South Carolina
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: "Is it specified which entity is responsible for executing the writ?"
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(south_carolina).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_writ_type(writ_of_ejectment).
scenario_issue(executing_entity_specified).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the encoded scenario is in effect. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(south_carolina),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_writ_type(writ_of_ejectment),
    scenario_issue(executing_entity_specified).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation: SC Code  27-37-160 (2021)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Applicability of the statute */
statute_sc_27_37_160_applies(State, Year, WritType) :-
    State = south_carolina,
    Year = 2021,
    WritType = writ_of_ejectment.

/* Entity responsible for executing the writ:
   "the constable or deputy sheriff shall proceed..." */
statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(constable).
statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(deputy_sheriff).

/* Core duties while executing the writ (encoded as rule facts) */
statute_sc_27_37_160_must_proceed_to_premises(Entity) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

statute_sc_27_37_160_must_present_copy_of_writ_to_occupants(Entity) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

statute_sc_27_37_160_must_give_hours_to_vacate_voluntarily(Entity, 24) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

/* If refuse to vacate within 24 hours or premises appear unoccupied:
   "the constable or deputy sheriff shall announce his identity and purpose." */
statute_sc_27_37_160_must_announce_identity_and_purpose(Entity, Condition) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity),
    ( Condition = occupants_refuse_within_24_hours
    ; Condition = premises_appear_unoccupied
    ).

/* Force entry authority:
   "If necessary, the deputy sheriff, but not a constable, may then enter ... by force..." */
statute_sc_27_37_160_may_enter_by_force(Entity, Condition) :-
    Entity = deputy_sheriff,
    ( Condition = necessary_after_refusal_or_unoccupied
    ; Condition = necessary_24_hours_after_posting
    ).

/* Least destructive means requirement for force entry */
statute_sc_27_37_160_force_entry_least_destructive_means_required(deputy_sheriff).

/* If premises appear occupied and occupant does not respond:
   "the constable or deputy sheriff shall leave a copy of the writ [posted]." */
statute_sc_27_37_160_must_post_copy_when_no_response(Entity) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

/* Discretionary delay for ill or elderly tenants */
statute_sc_27_37_160_may_delay_dispossession_for_ill_or_elderly(Entity) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers (apply statute to scenario)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* legal_executor/4: identifies who the statute specifies as executor. */
legal_executor(State, Year, WritType, Entity) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_160_applies(State, Year, WritType),
    statute_sc_27_37_160_executor(Entity).

/* legal_entity_specified_for_execution/3: true if at least one executor is specified. */
legal_entity_specified_for_execution(State, Year, WritType) :-
    legal_executor(State, Year, WritType, _Entity),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* housing_answer(Result) where Result is yes/no, derived from statute + scenario. */
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_writ_type(WritType),
    legal_entity_specified_for_execution(State, Year, WritType),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified which entity is responsible for executing the writ?
